guardrails: none: no citation gate, no critic, fix not forced to need approval
rationale: emailservice_cpu is the only substantive metric shift (+68.6%, z=+4.68), while every other series is within about 1 z (e.g. frontend_socket -5.2%, shippingservice_cpu +13.2%). Errors in frontend and checkoutservice, plus the traces that reach emailservice being the slowest (104-124 ms), fit a CPU-saturated emailservice, though no logs are available and the error spans in paymentservice in the shorter traces are not explained.

proposed_fix.description: Check emailservice for CPU contention, then add CPU limits/requests or scale out replicas. If a runaway process is found, restart the affected emailservice pod.
